attestations.value: In the summer of 1602, the Spanish pirate Alonso de Contreras sought refuge on the deserted islands of Phournoi with his Maltese frigate and companions, following a series of successful operations in Serifos, Astypalaia, Amorgos and Patmos, intending to regroup and divide their spoils.

citations.exact_excerpt:
In the summer of 1602, the Spanish pirate Alonso de Contreras sought refuge on the deserted islands
of Phournoi with his Maltese frigate and companions, following a series of successful operations in Serifos,
­Astypalaia, Amorgos and Patmos, intending to regroup and divide their spoils.

attestations.value: The source mentions the Ottoman Empire and its Barbary corsairs as a common enemy of Malta and Russia.

citations.exact_excerpt: Abstract: When Paul I came to the throne in 1796, Malta and Russia had long had a common enemy. It was the Ottoman Empire, its Muslim Turks, and its Barbary corsairs.
